metadata.description: Open-source mods for Claude Code: panes, bands, status lines, toasts and hooks, written as plugins of function hooks.

plugins.name: agent-flow
plugins.description: Animated timeline pane of the orchestrator and its subagents: who is thinking, acting or waiting, and the messages between them

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt showing the model and effort, context %, cache hit rate, and session and weekly limits, with a click-to-expand row for tools, skills and MCP share of context

plugins.name: threads
plugins.description: Side pane to track open questions, doubts and ideas as threads, per session or saved per project, with threads Claude suggests for you to accept or dismiss
